facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft) 14 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 25; earlier seasons: May 17 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft).

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 30.7 in (2023), 22.6 in (2024), 28.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: 13.2 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 24.6 in (2023), 19.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 22 and July 1, carried from the melt-out date at Sasse Ridge (4,340 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Sasse Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 25, 1,808 ft below the pass; points to April 22 to July 1
